stance: Consumer sentiment is weak, near this year's low. Prelim Oct at 46.3 is down 1.8 from 48.1 in Sep and 5.4 below Aug at 51.7, so the drift is lower after the May low of 44.8 (unconfirmed, from a calendar page). Soft sentiment hints at softer retail sales, though the two often decouple. Watch 5-10y inflation expectations for Fed anchoring risk, and the final Oct reading on 23 Oct (calendar estimate). A final above 48 would end the decline.
